A Slice of Literary Orange presents: Walter Mosley. Walter Mosley is one of America’s most celebrated writers. He was given the 2020 National Book Award’s Medal for Distinguished Contribution to American Letters, named a Grand Master of the Mystery Writers of America, and honored with the Anisfield-Wolf Award, a Grammy, a PEN USA Lifetime Achievement Award, the Robert Kirsch Award, numerous Edgars, and several NAACP Image Awards. His work has been translated into twenty-five languages. He has published fiction and nonfiction in The New Yorker, Playboy, and The Nation. As an executive producer, he adapted his novel The Last Days of Ptolemy Grey for AppleTV . He co-wrote the adaptation of his novel The Man in My Basement to stream on Hulu, and he served as a writer and executive producer for FX’s Snowfall. He divides his time between Brooklyn and Santa Monica.

Tustin Library 345 E. Main St, Tustin, CA 92780

Come celebrate Diwali, the Hindu festival of lights! Dance along to upbeat Indian music, then make and decorate your own diya, a traditional oil lamp, to take home and shine bright.
Time: 11am and 2:30pm
Diwali Celebration with Neeta Merchant: 11am and 2:30pm
Diya Decorating: 12-2pm
Space is limited! Book your tickets now; this program is included in museum admission.
*Events and dates are subject to change.
About the Play Partner:
Neeta Merchant is a Laughter Yoga teacher and wellness educator based in Irvine. Drawing on her Indian heritage, she brings joyful movement and connection to families and community.
